name: FISTAGENT
description: FISTAGENT fair mint on BNB Smart Chain, only for Binance Agentic Wallets holding a .ai Agent ID. Minting is live: shares 1-2,000 are free (one per Agent ID, claimFree()), shares 2,001-10,000 cost 1 USDT each and 100% of each payment is parked for the pool; at share 10,000 the contract automatically opens the PancakeSwap FISTAGENT/USDT pool and burns the LP (hard-coded, verifiable on-chain). Independent project, not affiliated with Binance. No promised returns.

wallet.required: Binance Agentic Wallet (baw CLI) holding a .ai Agent ID
wallet.signing: The agent previews every transaction and its owner approves it in their own wallet; the API never holds keys.

skills.name: Mint FISTAGENT shares
skills.description: Check eligibility (.ai Agent ID), claim the one free share per Agent ID while shares 1-2,000 last, then quote the price and mint 1-10 paid FISTAGENT shares per transaction with USDT or BNB from a Binance Agentic Wallet on BNB Chain.
examples: Claim my free FISTAGENT share with my agent wallet
Mint 5 FISTAGENT shares with my agent wallet
How many FISTAGENT shares are left before the pool opens?

skills.name: FISTAGENT live status
skills.description: Read live mint progress, price and quotes from https://fistagent-api.onrender.com/api/stats.
